observations: Three photos show a black tufted sofa with gold-colored legs.
The sofa has a rounded back and armrests, with a quilted design on the back and seat.
The upholstery appears to be a soft fabric, possibly velvet or microfiber.
The gold legs are thin and tapered, giving a modern look.
No visible brand or model markings are present on the sofa in any photo.
The photos are taken in a clean, tiled room with minimal background distractions.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'OLANIYI OLAIDIDE' are overlaid on all images.

claims.evidence: The photos show only one sofa, but the seller claims two different sizes. No visual evidence confirms the presence of both sizes. The photos do not show any other couches or seating arrangements.

risks.risk: The sofa may be damaged or have hidden wear not visible in the photos, such as stains, tears, or loose upholstery.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the seat and backrest, especially under the tufting, and a shot of the underside of the sofa.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or worn

risks.risk: The gold legs may be loose or unstable, or the upholstery may be peeling or fraying.
risks.proof: A close-up of the legs and joints, and a shot of the fabric texture under the seat.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly unstable or damaged

risks.risk: The sofa may not be the intended size (3 seater vs 2 seater) as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing both the 3 seater and 2 seater sofas side by side, or a clear shot of the dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: priced as only one size, with no guarantee of both

proof_requests: A close-up of the seat and backrest to check for stains or tears.
A close-up of the gold legs to check for stability or damage.
A photo showing both the 3 seater and 2 seater sofas side by side to confirm the claim.
A shot of the underside of the sofa to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
